title: Bug: 10 QoS SAI PFC/watermark tests fail on Arista-7060X6-64PE-O128 / TH5
author: rgarofano-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

10 QoS SAI tests consistently fail HWSKU  Arista-7060X6-64PE-B-O128 , Broadcom TH5, topology  lt2-o128 . Over the last 30 days these 10 cases failed in all 6 runs with 0 passes — this is a persistent, reproducible failure, not flaky.

Most recent run: image  SONiC.20251110.42 

Here is a list of failing tests:

     testQosSaiPfcXoffLimit[single_asic-xoff_1] 
     testQosSaiPfcXoffLimit[single_asic-xoff_2] 
     testQosSaiPfcXonLimit[single_asic-xon_1] 
     testQosSaiPfcXonLimit[single_asic-xon_2] 
     testQosSaiLossyQueue[single_asic] 
     testQosSaiPgSharedWatermark[single_asic-wm_pg_shared_lossless] 
     testQosSaiPgSharedWatermark[single_asic-wm_pg_shared_lossy] 
     testQosSaiPgHeadroomWatermark[single_asic] 
     testQosSaiQSharedWatermark[single_asic-wm_q_shared_lossless] 
     testQosSaiQSharedWatermark[single_asic-wm_q_shared_lossy]

All tests point to PFC thresholds / buffer occupancy being accounted differently than the test expects on this TH5 SKU — likely a buffer-profile or SDK/SAI watermark accounting issue rather than a test logic bug.

Could you please help address this issue?

Image:  SONiC.20251110.42 
HWSKU:  Arista-7060X6-64PE-O128 

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `qos/test_qos_sai.py` with HWSKU  Arista-7060X6-64PE-B-O128 , Broadcom TH5, topology  lt2-o128.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

These tests are all expected to pass.
